categories.name: broad_functional_correctness_overrode_specific_criterion
categories.diagnosis: The model treated question form or possible failure as a67 even when the requested remedy centered on API ergonomics/evolution, dead-code removal, error prevention, or performance discipline.
categories.prompt_action: Identify the requested remedy and operational object before considering the broad correctness fallback.

categories.name: surface_lexical_trigger_overrode_normative_object
categories.diagnosis: Trigger words such as deprecated, reflection, variable purpose, and pyupgrade pulled the model to API evolution, magic, naming, or style instead of dependency removal, abstraction stability, unused-code removal, or automated enforcement.
categories.prompt_action: Use lexical triggers only after checking what object is changed and why.

categories.name: adjacent_leaf_boundary_or_primary_consequence_error
categories.diagnosis: The model chose a plausible sibling but failed the bank's exact boundary: PR focus versus VCS, simplicity versus smell, test intent versus test-design quality, evolvability versus coupling, expression clarity versus KISS, public-surface usability versus general API ergonomics, information hiding versus visibility organization, or behavior-focused tests versus runtime defense.
categories.prompt_action: Apply explicit pairwise boundary tests; abstain family-only when the quoted clause does not uniquely decide the leaf.
